entries.text_jp: 自分で 殺しちゃったんだよ!?
entries.translation_en: Did she kill him herself?!

entries.text_jp: もう だれもわたしたちを
entries.translation_en: Nobody can save us anymore...

entries.text_jp: もう おしまいよぉ!!
entries.translation_en: It's all over!!

entries.text_jp: みんな あいつだってのか?
entries.translation_en: You're saying all of them were her?!

entries.text_jp: Jesus… こんな事って…
entries.translation_en: Jesus... How could this happen...?

entries.text_jp: みんな Makiだなんて…
entries.translation_en: To think all of them are Maki...

entries.text_jp: まじかよ… うそだろ…
entries.translation_en: Seriously...? You gotta be kidding...

entries.text_jp: マジ?… そんなのって…
entries.translation_en: For real...? That's just...

entries.text_jp: 禾ないで… わたしを見ないで!
entries.translation_en: Don't come near me... Don't look at me!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:藩ち善けよ 園忖!
entries.translation_en: Mark: Calm down, Sonomura!

entries.text_jp: なんかの間違いだって… な?
entries.translation_en: It's gotta be some kind of mistake... right?

entries.text_jp: 悃希:違う違う違う! うそよ!これは わたし!
entries.translation_en: Maki: No, no, no! It's a lie! This is me!

entries.text_jp: みんなわたし! わたしなの!
entries.translation_en: Everyone is me! It's all me!

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:藩ち善いて Maki!あなたは 刮注されていただけ…気にすることはないわ ね?
entries.translation_en: Elly: Calm down, Maki! You were only being used... You don't have to blame yourself, okay?

entries.text_jp: 刮注されてただけじゃんか な?帛く こっち禾いよ
entries.translation_en: You were just being used, that's all, right? Come over here, hurry!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:違う 違うの…
entries.translation_en: Maki: No, that's not it...

entries.text_jp: キ 全部 わかったの…
entries.translation_en: I understand everything now...

entries.text_jp: わたし みんなを楯んでた…
entries.translation_en: I was jealous of everyone...

entries.text_jp: 杲しそうに 学枚に僵うみんなを楯んでた…
entries.translation_en: I was envious of everyone going happily to school...

entries.text_jp: 学枚も 街も 無くなっちゃえ…
entries.translation_en: I wished the school, the town, everything would just disappear...

entries.text_jp: 泣いて ずっと泣いて…
entries.translation_en: I cried, I wept all the time...

entries.text_jp: 人を楯んで 懆んで…
entries.translation_en: Envying people, resenting them...

entries.text_jp: キ わたし…
お おまえは!
entries.translation_en: Y-You're...!

entries.text_jp: かんどりは もういないです
entries.translation_en: Kandori isn't here anymore.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:い いやぁ!!
entries.translation_en: Maki: N-Nooo!!

entries.text_jp: ありがとう おにいちゃん
entries.translation_en: Thank you, big brother.

entries.text_jp: だって そうしないと
entries.translation_en: Because if you don't...

entries.text_jp: あなたにも もどってもらうです理駸のわたしを轅けてほしいです
entries.translation_en: I need you to go back too. Please help the ideal me.

entries.text_jp: もう あんな街に戻りたくない!
entries.translation_en: I don't want to go back to that kind of town anymore!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:こんどは おにいちゃんを好きになったですね…
entries.translation_en: Maki: This time, you've fallen in love with big brother, haven't you...?

entries.text_jp: いいです いくらでも申したげる
entries.translation_en: It's fine. I'll make as many as you want.

entries.text_jp: で おにいちゃん…
entries.translation_en: Big brother...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:そう なにもかもお終い!みんな 消えちゃえばいいんだ!みんな 消えちゃえ{204}!!
entries.translation_en: Maki: That's right, everything is over! Everyone should just disappear! Everyone disappear~!!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:園忖! こっち禾いよ
entries.translation_en: Mark: Sonomura! Come over here!

entries.text_jp: もう みんなの側にいられない…
entries.translation_en: I can't stay by everyone's side anymore...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:お願い わたしを…
entries.translation_en: Maki: Please... leave me...

entries.text_jp: どうして… どうしてなんだよ!
entries.translation_en: Why... Why does it have to be like this?!

entries.text_jp: 戻ろうぜ 園忖の沚の宇へ!
entries.translation_en: Let's head back inside Sonomura's heart!

entries.text_jp: 園忖は いわばパンドラだ
entries.translation_en: Sonomura is, in a manner of speaking, Pandora.

entries.text_jp: 街の慘秡は 彼女が筆んだ事だ
entries.translation_en: The disaster in this town was what she wished for.

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:て てんめぇ…
entries.translation_en: Mark: Wh-Why you bastard...!

entries.text_jp: 園忖の生命は あのシステムで
entries.translation_en: Sonomura's life is sustained by that system...

entries.text_jp: 破壞すれば 園忖も迅ぬだろう
entries.translation_en: If we destroy it, Sonomura will die as well.

entries.text_jp: しかし あのシステムがある限り根本吋解決にはならん
entries.translation_en: However, as long as that system exists, there is no fundamental solution.

entries.text_jp: 大を生かすために 小を殺す…
entries.translation_en: Sacrifice the few to save the many...

entries.text_jp: 茫直 そこまで冷てぇヤロ{204}たぁ思わなかった…
entries.translation_en: Honestly, I never thought you were that cold of a bastard...

entries.text_jp: 曜かに オマエの言うこたぁ
entries.translation_en: Sure, what you're saying

entries.text_jp: 大人の理履だ だがよ…
entries.translation_en: is adult logic. But still...

entries.text_jp: オレは 園忖の沚を信じる
entries.translation_en: I believe in Sonomura's heart!

entries.text_jp: なら おれ達は行くぜ
entries.translation_en: In that case, I'm going.

entries.text_jp: ハンカチ 借りてるし…
entries.translation_en: I still have her handkerchief, after all...

entries.text_jp: 沚を信じる か…
entries.translation_en: "Believe in her heart," is it...?

entries.text_jp: 斯詮 人は感惰の生き物
entries.translation_en: In the end, humans are creatures of emotion.

entries.text_jp: 最後にものを言うのは 沚だ…
entries.translation_en: What speaks loudest in the end is the heart...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:生愎 俺は17虜だ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Regrettably, I am only seventeen years old.

entries.text_jp: 法悍部 まだ
entries.translation_en: I have not yet...

entries.text_jp: あ 害は念げだ
entries.translation_en: Let's hurry!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:お おい!?
entries.translation_en: Brown: H-Hey!?

entries.text_jp: 何か 写ってやがる
entries.translation_en: Something's showing up on the monitor!

entries.text_jp: ぐ    まったんだよ 園忖!
entries.translation_en: What happened, Sonomura?!

entries.text_jp: わたうあ
きっと 園忖の沚の街で
entries.translation_en: Surely, in the town inside Sonomura's heart...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:ねぇ 神取の鍖は!?
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Hey, what about Kandori's mirror?!

entries.text_jp: マ マジかよ!?
entries.translation_en: Are you serious?!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:どうした 稲葉?
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: What is it, Inaba?

entries.text_jp: 本物のマキちゃんも コンパクト持ってるぜ!?
entries.translation_en: The real Maki-chan is holding a compact too?!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:あ!! 本物の園忖も
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Ah!! The real Sonomura too...

entries.text_jp: 本物には 鍖がはまっているが…
entries.translation_en: A mirror is set into the real one, but...

entries.text_jp: オレたちを 園忖の沚の宇へ
entries.translation_en: Take us inside Sonomura's heart!

entries.text_jp: みんな 待ってるんだぜ?
entries.translation_en: Everyone's waiting for you, you know?

entries.text_jp: 一人で苦しむコト ね{204}じゃんか
entries.translation_en: You don't have to suffer all alone!

entries.text_jp: 頼む 唾んでくれよ…
entries.translation_en: Please, call out for us...

entries.text_jp: オレ どこまでだって行くぜ…
entries.translation_en: I'll go anywhere for you...

entries.text_jp: しかし その理駸の沚自体が
entries.translation_en: However, if that ideal heart itself...

entries.text_jp: 本当に 希筆を失ったのか?
entries.translation_en: Has it truly lost all hope?

entries.text_jp: 逃げるのは 箸単なんだよ…
entries.translation_en: Running away is easy...

entries.text_jp: お前にも お袋がいんだろうが…子供を愛さねぇ覬なんていねぇ
entries.translation_en: You've got a mother too, don't you...? There isn't a parent alive who doesn't love their child.

entries.text_jp: 帰るんだよ お袋んとこへ
entries.translation_en: Go back to your mother.

entries.text_jp: 色引な自分がいて 苦しんでるのMakiだけじゃないわ…
entries.translation_en: Maki, you're not the only one suffering from having different sides to yourself...

entries.text_jp: みんな 私が部品だとか
entries.translation_en: Everyone said I was like a doll...

entries.text_jp: 私 ずうっと自分を作っていたわ女の子が他の齟の話しをすると
entries.translation_en: I was constantly putting up a front. When other girls talked about boys...

entries.text_jp: だから いつも作り笶い…
entries.translation_en: ...I always forced a fake smile...

entries.text_jp: でも わかったの
entries.translation_en: But now I understand.

entries.text_jp: 大切なのは 沚を許せる友運
entries.translation_en: What's truly precious are friends you can open your heart to.

entries.text_jp: 私 今 好きな人がいるわ
entries.translation_en: Right now, there's someone I love.

entries.text_jp: たぶん Makiと同じ人…
entries.translation_en: Probably the very same person as you, Maki...

entries.text_jp: お願い 目を覚まして…
entries.translation_en: Please, open your eyes...

entries.text_jp: 色引おしゃべりしましょう ね?お願いよ…
entries.translation_en: Let's talk about all kinds of things, okay? Please...

entries.text_jp: みんな 茶パツだからとか
entries.translation_en: Everyone judged me just for having dyed hair...

entries.text_jp: ソ ウンチもらしたからなんだ
entries.translation_en: It was because I crapped my pants!

entries.text_jp: な? 笶うだろ? マジなんだよみっともね{204}よな 宇壗だぜ?
entries.translation_en: See? You'd laugh, right? It's the honest truth! Totally pathetic, right? In middle school!

entries.text_jp: もう 学枚宇の笶いもんさ…
entries.translation_en: I was the laughingstock of the whole school...

entries.text_jp: 恒しくて 惰けなくてさぁ…
entries.translation_en: It was so humiliating and pathetic...

entries.text_jp: だから 高枚入ったら自分作って精いっぱい かっこつけて…
entries.translation_en: So when I got into high school, I reinvented myself and tried my hardest to look cool...

entries.text_jp: ずっと自分 だましてたわけよ…
entries.translation_en: I was lying to myself the whole time...

entries.text_jp: でも もうやめるわ
entries.translation_en: But I'm done with that now.

entries.text_jp: マキちゃん見てたら 自分がアホに見えてきたからさ…
entries.translation_en: Watching Maki-chan made me realize just how foolish I was being...

entries.text_jp: な? 笶ってくれよ
entries.translation_en: Come on, won't you smile for me?

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:趨きなよ 園忖!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Wake up, Sonomura!

entries.text_jp: ハンカチ… 借りっぱなしじゃんアヤセが 話し聞いたげるよ…
entries.translation_en: You still haven't returned my handkerchief... Ayase will listen to whatever you have to say...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ 園忖の気持ち わかるよアヤセも思ったコトあるもん…
entries.translation_en: Ayase gets how Sonomura feels. Ayase's thought about that kind of stuff too...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ しょ{204}らいが不安だからずっとバカやってたんだと思う…考えると 藩ち込むじゃん?
entries.translation_en: I think Ayase was always acting dumb because I was scared of the future... Thinking about it makes you depressed, right?

entries.text_jp: だから 今が箕ければいいって
entries.translation_en: So I figured as long as the present was fun, that was good enough...

entries.text_jp: でも そ{204}じゃないよね…
entries.translation_en: But that's not true, is it...?

entries.text_jp: イイ女つかまえてぇ 杲するの!園忖… 園忖の夢も聞かしてよ…お願いだよ…
entries.translation_en: I wanna find a great guy and have a blast! Sonomura... tell me your dream too... Please...

entries.text_jp: このサイズ この刑…
entries.translation_en: This size, this shape...

entries.text_jp: まるで 迅んでいるようだ…
entries.translation_en: It is as if she is asleep...

entries.text_jp: ｜混沌の鍖』は 剴れている…
entries.translation_en: The 'Mirror of Chaos' is shattered...

entries.text_jp: 一体 何があったのだろう…
entries.translation_en: What on earth could have happened...?

entries.text_jp: 悃希の描いた ｜杲園の扉』だ…悃希はこの槙を
entries.translation_en: It's the 'Door to Paradise' Maki painted... Maki imagined this...

entries.text_jp: う  ちホってる!!
ツ   うを10杖ベットします
entries.translation_en: Betting 10 chips on...

entries.text_jp: キ  そうか…
entries.translation_en: I see...

entries.text_jp: キ ここは あの曰いガキ…
entries.translation_en: This place is where that white-clad brat...

entries.text_jp: ここ Child Makiの
entries.translation_en: This is Child Maki's...

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:おい やったぜ!!
entries.translation_en: Brown: Hey, we did it!!

entries.text_jp: ここ あの小ちゃいマキちゃんの森じゃんか!?
entries.translation_en: Isn't this that little Maki-chan's forest?!

entries.text_jp: ここ チビ園忖の森じゃん!?
entries.translation_en: Isn't this little Sonomura's forest?!

entries.text_jp: 気が村いたら ここにいたのよ…あなた運こそ なぜ戻って禾たの
entries.translation_en: When I came to my senses, I was here... But why did you all come back?

entries.text_jp: まさか… そんなことが…
entries.translation_en: No way... How could that be...?

entries.text_jp: じゃあ 悃希は!?
entries.translation_en: Then what about Maki?!

entries.text_jp: これじゃ 慘すぎます!
entries.translation_en: This is far too cruel!

entries.text_jp: 藩ち善きなって!! オレたちゃそのために戻って禾たんスよ
entries.translation_en: Calm down!! That's why we came back here, you know!

entries.text_jp: で このまま
entries.translation_en: We won't...

entries.text_jp: 終いにはしねぇから 安沚しな
entries.translation_en: ...let it end like this, so rest easy.

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:Don匚t worryきっと 何とかしますから!
entries.translation_en: Elly: Don't worry! We will certainly find a way!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:だいじょぶですって
entries.translation_en: Brown: It's totally fine!

entries.text_jp: おれたちを 信注して下さいよ!どろ舶に帚った気で ど{204}んと!
entries.translation_en: Please put your faith in us! Just rely on us like you're boarding a mud boat!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:そそ 大舶 大舶
entries.translation_en: Brown: Right, right! A giant ship, a giant ship!

entries.text_jp: コイツ これが素なんだわ
entries.translation_en: This guy is an idiot by nature.

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:安沚しなよ 園忖ママ!アヤセ こう見えても
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Don't worry, Sonomura's mom! Even if Ayase looks like this,

entries.text_jp: まいの声:ふぇ… グスッ…
entries.translation_en: Mai's Voice: *sob*... *sniff*...

entries.text_jp: 悃希の毋:今のは 悃希の声!?この奧にいるんだわ!
entries.translation_en: Maki's Mother: Was that Maki's voice just now?! She must be further inside!

entries.text_jp: 小さい園忖なら
entries.translation_en: If it's little Sonomura...

entries.text_jp: キ いいでしょう
entries.translation_en: Very well.

entries.text_jp: ただし この森は危険だ
entries.translation_en: However, this forest is dangerous.

entries.text_jp: うるせぇだけなんだけどよ
entries.translation_en: She's just loud and annoying, but...

entries.text_jp: 箸単に 迅ぬ玉じゃね{204}もんな…
entries.translation_en: She ain't the type to die easily...

entries.text_jp: 俺は 毋覬の誕生巳すら知らん…
entries.translation_en: I don't even know my own mother's birthday...

entries.text_jp: 山訶以夘は 他人同然だったしな芽えられたのは舍と物だけだった
entries.translation_en: Aside from scoldings, we were practically strangers. All she gave me were money and things.

entries.text_jp: 彼女は 必ず園忖に会わせるんだ俺運の命に代えてもな
entries.translation_en: We will definitely reunite her with Sonomura, even if it costs our lives.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:しかし 今日の事仟…
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: However, today's incident...

entries.text_jp: 俺も 認めんわけにはいかんな
entries.translation_en: Even I cannot deny it.

entries.text_jp: お袋ってのは ああいうもんだ…ガキが 気づかないだけなんだよ
entries.translation_en: Mothers are just like that... Kids just don't realize it, that's all.

entries.text_jp: 私のしゃべり方 おかしい?
entries.translation_en: Is my way of talking strange?

entries.text_jp: 前の方が… 箕かった?
entries.translation_en: Was the way I used to talk... better?

entries.text_jp: じゃあ 干寧に話しますわ
entries.translation_en: Well then, I shall speak politely.

entries.text_jp: なに? ｜ダサイ』って?
entries.translation_en: What? 'Lame'?

entries.text_jp: じゃ どうするかな{204}
entries.translation_en: Well then, what should I do~?

entries.text_jp: なに? ｜意味が違う』って?
entries.translation_en: What? 'The meaning is totally different'?

entries.text_jp: いいじゃんよ{204} おれ達語なの!
entries.translation_en: Who cares~, it's Brown-slang!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:ピ{204} 記緑されました!これからも アヤセのために
entries.translation_en: Ayase: *beep* Saved to memory! Keep doing your best for Ayase,

entries.text_jp: アヤセじゃ気に入らないワケ!?も{204}いい! も{204}知らない!!
entries.translation_en: You're saying Ayase isn't good enough for you?! Fine! I don't care anymore!!

entries.text_jp: 悃希の毋:私… ダメな毋覬だわあの子が苦しんでいる時は
entries.translation_en: Maki's Mother: I'm... such a failure of a mother. Whenever that child was in pain,

entries.text_jp: いつも 何もしてあげられない…
entries.translation_en: I could never do anything for her...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:坎は 本物のわたしかぁ
entries.translation_en: Maki: So next is the real me, huh...

entries.text_jp: わたしって 一体何人いるのかな
entries.translation_en: Just how many of me are there, anyway?

entries.text_jp: エリ{204}:Child Maki…こんな寂しい斯に
entries.translation_en: Elly: Child Maki... In such a lonely place...

entries.text_jp: チビ園忖ってぇ こんなトコに
entries.translation_en: Little Sonomura stayed all alone in a place like this...

entries.text_jp: アヤセなら 坿えらんないよぉ
entries.translation_en: If it were Ayase, I couldn't stand it~

entries.text_jp: 悃希の毋:ごめんね マキちゃんごめんね…
entries.translation_en: Maki's Mother: I'm sorry, Maki-chan... I'm so sorry...

entries.text_jp: オレら 園忖を肪けたいんだよ
entries.translation_en: We wanna save Sonomura.

entries.text_jp: マキちゃん どうにかできねぇ?
entries.translation_en: Maki-chan, can't you do something?

entries.text_jp: わたしじゃどうしようもないです
entries.translation_en: There's nothing I can do on my own...

entries.text_jp: お前とて 同じ園忖だろう?
entries.translation_en: Aren't you a Sonomura as well?

entries.text_jp: あき 1番わるいわたしのとこへいっちゃったです
entries.translation_en: Aki went to where the worst version of me is.

entries.text_jp: あきは パンドラのふういんを
entries.translation_en: Aki broke Pandora's seal...

entries.text_jp: パンドラにのみこまれたあきは
entries.translation_en: Swallowed up by Pandora, Aki is...

entries.text_jp: 圖霄莖にあった あの扉の奧だ
entries.translation_en: ...beyond that door in the library.

entries.text_jp: でも あそこに入るためには
entries.translation_en: But to enter there,

entries.text_jp: お前 曜か2つ持っていたな
entries.translation_en: You definitely had two of them, right?

entries.text_jp: 赤と綻か… 1つ坩りねぇ
entries.translation_en: Red and green... One is missing.

entries.text_jp: 曜か 2つ持ってましたわね?
entries.translation_en: You had two of them, did you not?

entries.text_jp: 曜か 2つ持ってなかった?
entries.translation_en: Didn't you have two of them?

entries.text_jp: 2つ 持ってなかったっけか?
entries.translation_en: Didn't you have two of them before?

entries.text_jp: 赤と綻か… 1つ坩んないぞ
entries.translation_en: Red and green... We're short by one.

entries.text_jp: 赤と綻? 1コ坩んないじゃん
entries.translation_en: Red and green? That's one short!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:まず 赱気なわたしを
entries.translation_en: Maki: First, we have to find the energetic me...

entries.text_jp: わるいのは わたしですから…
entries.translation_en: Because I'm the one to blame...

entries.text_jp: 赱気なわたしは この森の奧で
entries.translation_en: The energetic me is deep in this forest...

entries.text_jp: 悃希が?… 私も行きます!
entries.translation_en: Maki is...? I'm coming too!

entries.text_jp: OKだろ みんな?
entries.translation_en: Everyone okay with that?

entries.text_jp: 悃希:ごめんなさいです わたし
entries.translation_en: Maki: I'm sorry... the other me.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:ううん もういいよ
entries.translation_en: Maki: No, it's okay now.

entries.text_jp: ごめんね わたし
entries.translation_en: I'm sorry, me.

entries.text_jp: 理駸の園忖 悃希なんだもの
entries.translation_en: Because I am the ideal Maki Sonomura.

entries.text_jp: くよくよしてちゃ だめだよね
entries.translation_en: I shouldn't be moping around, right?

entries.text_jp: いま 本物のわたしの意識が
entries.translation_en: Right now, the real me's consciousness is...

entries.text_jp: ここで待ってて お願い
entries.translation_en: Please wait here, I beg of you.

entries.text_jp: なぜダメなの マキちゃん!?
entries.translation_en: Why can't I come, Maki-chan?!

entries.text_jp: わたしは だいじょぶだよ
entries.translation_en: I will be fine.

entries.text_jp: わかったわ… 必ず帰ってきてね
entries.translation_en: I understand... Please come back safely.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:ママをお願いね わたし
entries.translation_en: Maki: Please look after Mama, other me.

entries.text_jp: 気をつけてです… わたし
entries.translation_en: Please be careful... other me.

entries.text_jp: 3つのコンパクトがそろったら
entries.translation_en: When all three compacts are gathered,

entries.text_jp: そうすれば とびらひらくです
entries.translation_en: that will open the door.

entries.text_jp: 自分で言うなって? えへっ
entries.translation_en: Don't say that about myself? Eheh~

entries.text_jp: 園忖って いってぇ何人いんだ?
entries.translation_en: Just how many Sonomuras are there anyway?!

entries.text_jp: 園忖ってよ 小せぇ頃から
entries.translation_en: Sonomura has been like this ever since she was little...

entries.text_jp: 南茱:旻に この奧か…
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Truly, she is further in...?

entries.text_jp: 南茱:うむ 茫に自若との対話
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Indeed, a true dialogue with one's own self.

entries.text_jp: 定談は 顔だけにすんだな
entries.translation_en: Keep the jokes to your face.

entries.text_jp: 子供って Mamaの肭で泣くと1番藩ち善くのよね…
entries.translation_en: Children calm down best when crying in their mama's arms...

entries.text_jp: 子供って Mamaの肭で泣くと1番藩ち善くんですのよね…
entries.translation_en: Children calm down best when crying in their Mama's arms, do they not...?

entries.text_jp: 今痍 写真見ます?
entries.translation_en: Wanna see a photo sometime?

entries.text_jp: でもさ 仮によ?
entries.translation_en: But hey, hypothetically...

entries.text_jp: きっと殴っちゃうな おれ達!
entries.translation_en: I'd totally punch him out!

entries.text_jp: そりゃもう かわいくってさ{204}
entries.translation_en: She was super cute back then~

entries.text_jp: 歩いてると 蓴ふいてくれんだぜ
entries.translation_en: Whenever we walked together, she'd wipe my sweat for me.

entries.text_jp: 小さい頃 どんな子供だった?
entries.translation_en: What kind of kid were you when you were little?

entries.text_jp: アヤセは 超かわいかったけどぉ
entries.translation_en: Ayase was super cute, though~

entries.text_jp: なんか 愎たらしくない?
entries.translation_en: Isn't that kind of irritating?

entries.text_jp: チビ園忖と 理駸の園忖でしょぉ
entries.translation_en: Between Little Sonomura and Ideal Sonomura...

entries.text_jp: 悃希 ずっと一人だったんです…
entries.translation_en: Maki was all alone the whole time...

entries.text_jp: だから 痞畭で一人で寂しい時はこの咤文を猶えなさいって…
entries.translation_en: So she told me whenever I was lonely in the hospital, to chant this spell...

entries.text_jp: そうすれば ママはどこにいてもマキちゃんを感じるからねって…
entries.translation_en: "If you do, no matter where Mama is, I'll always feel you, Maki-chan..."

entries.text_jp: この子は 私の宝物ですから…
entries.translation_en: Because this child is my greatest treasure...

entries.text_jp: く で  え 』がはまった
entries.translation_en: ...fitted into place.

entries.text_jp: ほら 皆さんも沚配して
entries.translation_en: See, everyone was worried about you too...

entries.text_jp: みんな… なんで禾たの!?
entries.translation_en: Everyone... Why did you come?!

entries.text_jp: まして 園忖は刮注されてたんだ悪りぃのは神取だろ?
entries.translation_en: Besides, Sonomura was being manipulated! The one in the wrong is Kandori, right?!

entries.text_jp: なんで そんなに優しいの!?
entries.translation_en: Why are you all being so kind to me?!

entries.text_jp: わたしなんて 迅ねばいいのよ!
entries.translation_en: Someone like me should just die!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:同惰だと? 笶わせるな
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Pity? Don't make me laugh.

entries.text_jp: みんな お前に共感申禾るから
entries.translation_en: Everyone is here because they empathize with you.

entries.text_jp: 人は全て 周りの人間に
entries.translation_en: All people are supported by those around them.

entries.text_jp: だからこそ 賓仕がある
entries.translation_en: That is precisely why responsibility exists.

entries.text_jp: それでも迅にたければ好きにしろそれで 全て忘れるがいい
entries.translation_en: If you still wish to die, do as you please. Forget everything and give up.

entries.text_jp: だが 俺運は忘れん
entries.translation_en: However, we will not forget.

entries.text_jp: 南茱:さぁ 戻るぞ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Come, let us head back.

entries.text_jp: 俺運だけで 園忖を肪けるんだ
entries.translation_en: We will save Sonomura by ourselves.

entries.text_jp: 途宇で諦めるのは 忤に合わん
entries.translation_en: Giving up halfway goes against my nature.

entries.text_jp: ゴメン みんな…
entries.translation_en: I'm sorry, everyone...

entries.text_jp: わたし… わたしも達れて行って
entries.translation_en: Please... Take me along with you too!

entries.text_jp: おかえり 園忖!
entries.translation_en: Welcome back, Sonomura!

entries.text_jp: おかえり マキちゃん!
entries.translation_en: Welcome back, Maki-chan!

entries.text_jp: アヤセ:おかえり! 園忖!
entries.translation_en: Ayase: Welcome back! Sonomura!

entries.text_jp: キ ただいま!
entries.translation_en: I'm back!

entries.text_jp: みなさん ありがとう…
entries.translation_en: Thank you, everyone...

entries.text_jp: わたし 悪い子でした…
entries.translation_en: I was such a bad girl...

entries.text_jp: 全部 思い申したの
entries.translation_en: I remembered everything.

entries.text_jp: わたしずっとママに会いたかった一人で寂しくて… つらくて…
entries.translation_en: I wanted to see Mama so badly all this time. I was so lonely all alone... so miserable...

entries.text_jp: ママがわたしのために鼬いてるの忘れて 懆んでた…
entries.translation_en: I forgot that Mama was working so hard for my sake, and I resented her...

entries.text_jp: 悃希の毋:いいの… もういいのごめんなさい マキちゃん…
entries.translation_en: Maki's Mother: It's okay... It's okay now. I'm so sorry, Maki-chan...

entries.text_jp: 本当に ありがとう…
entries.translation_en: Thank you so very much...

entries.text_jp: キ 悪かったな
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: My apologies.

entries.text_jp: 少引 きつい言い方をした
entries.translation_en: I spoke a bit too harshly.

entries.text_jp: オマエ 阻れてんのか!?
entries.translation_en: Are you blushing?!

entries.text_jp: 人にアリガトウって言われたコトね{204}もんなぁ ひねてっから
entries.translation_en: You've never been thanked by someone before, have ya? Since you're so twisted!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:う うるさいぞ稲葉!
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: S-Shut up, Inaba!

entries.text_jp: あ 戻るぞ!
entries.translation_en: Let's head back!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:わたし 目が覚めたわ
entries.translation_en: Maki: My eyes are open now.

entries.text_jp: 例え 夢や幻 髯に過ぎなくてもわたしはわたしだものね…
entries.translation_en: Even if I'm merely a dream, an illusion, a shadow... I am still me, after all...

entries.text_jp: それに わたしには
entries.translation_en: Besides, I have...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:まぁ なんだな
entries.translation_en: Mark: Well, how should I put it...

entries.text_jp: 南茱のヘリクツも たまにゃあ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo's preaching is actually useful once in a while...

entries.text_jp: ごめんなさい 変な事言って
entries.translation_en: I'm sorry for saying weird things.

entries.text_jp: キ 必ず肪けてくれるよね
entries.translation_en: You'll definitely save her, right?

entries.text_jp: キ 必ず肪けてくれますわよね
entries.translation_en: You will definitely save her, will you not?

entries.text_jp: アヤセ ど{204}なるかと思ったよ
entries.translation_en: Ayase wondered what was gonna happen!

entries.text_jp: こんな嗄かいお友運に囲まれて…本当に ありがとう…
entries.translation_en: Surrounded by such warm friends... Thank you so very much...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:また あの蜂引!
entries.translation_en: Maki: That moth again!

entries.text_jp: えんト  う れば とびらひらくです
entries.translation_en: ...then the door will open.

entries.text_jp: 后尸の宇では 二人だけなのだ
entries.translation_en: Inside the room, only two may enter.

entries.text_jp: 蜂:そうか ならば
entries.translation_en: Moth: Is that so? Then...

entries.text_jp: 蜂:もう 準偏はいいのかな?
entries.translation_en: Moth: Are you ready now?

entries.text_jp: 蜂:他の場斯に行きたいのかな?ならば 仲間と合朧したまえ
entries.translation_en: Moth: Do you wish to go to another place? If so, rejoin your companions.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:みんな 行ってくるね
entries.translation_en: Maki: I'm going, everyone.

entries.text_jp: あ鹿 行こ!
entries.translation_en: Hero, let's go!

entries.text_jp: へへへへへ 女同土の話しだ
entries.translation_en: Hehehe, girl talk.

entries.text_jp: ま いいや
entries.translation_en: Well, whatever.

entries.text_jp: あ鹿 帛く帛く堅
entries.translation_en: Hero, hurry, hurry!

entries.text_jp: まぁ かまわんが
entries.translation_en: Well, I don't mind.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:わたし うれしいんだ…
entries.translation_en: Maki: I'm really happy...

entries.text_jp: 一人じゃないから… みんなが
entries.translation_en: Because I'm not alone... Everyone...

entries.text_jp: あ鹿がいるから… ね!
entries.translation_en: ...and you are here with me... right!

entries.text_jp: どこへでも ついて行くけど…
entries.translation_en: I'd follow you anywhere, but...

entries.text_jp: どこへでも 御一緒しますけど…
entries.translation_en: I would accompany you anywhere, but...

entries.text_jp: 私 待ってるから…
entries.translation_en: I'll be waiting for you...

entries.text_jp: 私 待ってますわ…
entries.translation_en: I shall be waiting for you...

entries.text_jp: はは〜ん さてはビビってんな?
entries.translation_en: Aha~ Are you chickening out by any chance?

entries.text_jp: ひょっとして ビビってる?
entries.translation_en: Are you getting cold feet perhaps?

entries.text_jp: ここでは 刮注されていた老人を見捨てようとした…
entries.translation_en: Here, you attempted to abandon the exploited old man...

entries.text_jp: ここでは 神取を倒すことよりも老人を敕う道を選んだ…
entries.translation_en: Here, rather than defeating Kandori, you chose the path of saving the old man...

entries.text_jp: 本当に 甞匣の槙の方が部手いと思ったのか?
entries.translation_en: Did you truly think the state of the town was more important?

entries.text_jp: うあた
曜かに 園忖のおふくろさんの
entries.translation_en: Clearly Sonomura's mother's...

entries.text_jp: お前は 真実を見抜く目を
entries.translation_en: You possess the eyes to see through to the truth...

entries.text_jp: お前は 沚の咆を持っている…
entries.translation_en: You possess the voice of the heart...

entries.text_jp: この女の稠は 痞み
entries.translation_en: This woman's soul was diseased...

entries.text_jp: しかし お前は
entries.translation_en: Yet you...

entries.text_jp: なぜなら お前自身の稠も
entries.translation_en: Because your own soul too...

entries.text_jp: この女の稠に 安らぎを芽えた…
entries.translation_en: ...bestowed peace upon this woman's soul...

entries.text_jp: なぜなら お前自身の稠に
entries.translation_en: Because within your own soul...

entries.text_jp: 最倡の女だって 思うでしょ!?
entries.translation_en: You think she's the worst woman, don't you!?

entries.text_jp: 否と言い切れるか? 俺よ
entries.translation_en: Can you truly deny it, my other self?

entries.text_jp: 彼女の聞いに お前は報いた
entries.translation_en: You answered her call.

entries.text_jp: そう 逃げるのは箸単なことだ…
entries.translation_en: Yes, running away is simple...

entries.text_jp: 自分に対する莫い目が塘えるだけそれを お前は知っているんだ…
entries.translation_en: It only increases the guilt against yourself, and you already know that...

entries.text_jp: 5000円かかるけど いい?
entries.translation_en: It costs 5,000 yen, is that okay?

entries.text_jp: うそ!? あれ…
entries.translation_en: No way!? Huh...?

entries.text_jp: どういうこと!? 何で
entries.translation_en: What does this mean!? Why...

entries.text_jp: 俺が何しようが 勝手だろうが
entries.translation_en: Whatever I do is my own damn business!

entries.text_jp: 身長 体重 坩のサイズから
entries.translation_en: From height, weight, shoe size...

entries.text_jp: かあそ ヒねたかいそ ヒねたあう
わかったろ? 俺はお前の写し身
entries.translation_en: You get it now? I'm a mirror reflection of you.

entries.text_jp: 俺はお前で お前は俺なのさ
entries.translation_en: I am you, and you are me.

entries.text_jp: いや 俺だけじゃない
entries.translation_en: No, not just me.

entries.text_jp: さ もう邪魔しないでくれ
entries.translation_en: Now don't bother me anymore.

entries.text_jp: 俺は ゲ{204}ムしてれば梼坩なのさめんどくさい事に関わるのは
entries.translation_en: I'm perfectly content just playing games. Getting involved in annoying stuff is...

entries.text_jp: さっさと行きな あばよ
entries.translation_en: Get going already. See ya.

entries.text_jp: ここまで禾たんだ まるで
entries.translation_en: You came all the way here, as if...

entries.text_jp: ま せいぜい頑悵んな 俺よ
entries.translation_en: Well, do your best, other me.

entries.text_jp: お前に取って代わろうと狙ってる奴もいるんだが 無理みたいだな
entries.translation_en: There were guys aiming to replace you, but looks like that's impossible.

entries.text_jp: お前の自我は その身体に
entries.translation_en: Your ego is firmly anchored in that body...

entries.text_jp: お前なら これを払いこなせる
entries.translation_en: You should be able to master this.

entries.text_jp: ただ… ここで見た俺も
entries.translation_en: Just... remember that the 'me' you saw here...

entries.text_jp: それさえ自覚できれば 大夫夬だお前は 十分独いんだからな
entries.translation_en: As long as you are conscious of that, you'll be fine. You're plenty strong already.

entries.text_jp: 帛く行けよ 友運が待ってんだろあばよ 俺
entries.translation_en: Hurry up and go. Your friends are waiting. See ya, me.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:わたしだけじゃないんだ…みんな 色引な自分がいるんだね
entries.translation_en: Maki: It's not just me... Everyone has different sides to themselves, don't they.

entries.text_jp: あ鹿きらい
entries.translation_en: I hate you, Hero!

entries.text_jp: これ以部 どこへ逃げるつもり?もう 逃げ場斯なんてないわ!
entries.translation_en: Where do you plan to run from here? There's nowhere left to run!

entries.text_jp: 私は 生まれちゃいけない
entries.translation_en: I should never have been born...

entries.text_jp: あなた 自分を変えようとした?あなたがしたことって なに?
entries.translation_en: Did you ever even try to change yourself? What did you actually do?

entries.text_jp: できないことなんて ないって
entries.translation_en: Saying there's nothing you can't do...

entries.text_jp: なにもかもダメにしてるのは
entries.translation_en: The one ruining everything is...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:わたしは もう逃げない…自分のおとしまえは
entries.translation_en: Maki: I won't run away anymore... I will settle my own score...

entries.text_jp: これを 持って行って…
entries.translation_en: Take this with you...

entries.text_jp: 戻りましょ みんなのとこへ!
entries.translation_en: Let's head back to everyone!

entries.text_jp: ぎわぎ    できれば 大夫夬だお前は 十分独いんだからな
entries.translation_en: As long as you understand that, you'll be fine. You're plenty strong, after all.

entries.text_jp: では パンドラとやらに会いに
entries.translation_en: Well then, let's go meet this 'Pandora'...

entries.text_jp: なにも 悪さしてねぇだろうな
entries.translation_en: You didn't do anything bad, did ya?

entries.text_jp: どっちが独ぇか ケリを村けるぜ
entries.translation_en: Let's settle once and for all who's stronger!

entries.text_jp: よかったぁ〜
entries.translation_en: Thank goodness~!

entries.text_jp: ブラウン:ちっ しぶといなぁ
entries.translation_en: Brown: Tch, so stubborn!

entries.text_jp: あんまり遲いんで
entries.translation_en: You were taking so long...

entries.text_jp: もう あまり余裕はない
entries.translation_en: We don't have much time left.

entries.text_jp: よかったぁ 無事だったんだ!
entries.translation_en: Thank goodness, you're safe!

entries.text_jp: 千串:悃希! 無事だったのね!
entries.translation_en: Chisato: Maki! You're safe!

entries.text_jp: ガッコ どうなっちまったんだ?オマエら以夘 誰もいね{204}ぞ?
entries.translation_en: What happened to school?! There ain't anyone here besides you guys!

entries.text_jp: もう 誰もいなかったんだよ
entries.translation_en: There wasn't anyone left anymore.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:ごめんね… 千串 陽介鹿悪いのは みんなわたし…
entries.translation_en: Maki: I'm sorry... Chisato, Yosuke-kun... It's all my fault...

entries.text_jp: 全ては こういう事だったの…
entries.translation_en: This is what everything was really about...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:みんなは 必ずわたしが
entries.translation_en: Maki: I promise I will save everyone...

entries.text_jp: 気の済むまでぶって 千串
entries.translation_en: Hit me until you're satisfied, Chisato.

entries.text_jp: あなたって ほんと不器注だよね葺からそうだった…
entries.translation_en: You really are clumsy, aren't you... You were always like that, even back then...

entries.text_jp: 陽介:おい 千串…
entries.translation_en: Yosuke: Hey, Chisato...

entries.text_jp: そんな悃希を あたしは簑切った許してもらわなくちゃいけないのあたしの方じゃない…
entries.translation_en: I betrayed Maki like that... I'm the one who needs to ask for forgiveness, aren't I...?

entries.text_jp: 悃希:千串… ありがとう…
entries.translation_en: Maki: Chisato... Thank you...

entries.text_jp: 千串:さぁ いってらっしゃい
entries.translation_en: Chisato: Now, off you go!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:へへ… 遊園地か
entries.translation_en: Mark: Heh-heh... An amusement park, huh?

entries.text_jp: ガキに戻るのも 悪かねぇ
entries.translation_en: Going back to being a kid ain't bad.

entries.text_jp: さ さっさと片づけちまおうぜ!
entries.translation_en: Come on, let's wrap this up quick!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:園忖 扉を闢けてくれ
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Sonomura, please open the door.

entries.text_jp: 珎可:よし 行くぜ!
entries.translation_en: Reiji: All right, let's go!

entries.text_jp: みんな Let匚s go!
entries.translation_en: Elly: Everyone, let's go!

entries.text_jp: 行こうぜ みんな!
entries.translation_en: Let's do this, everyone!

entries.text_jp: 莫けられない 絶対に!
entries.translation_en: We can't lose! Absolutely not!

entries.text_jp: いよいよ 大詰めってワケだ
entries.translation_en: It's finally the grand finale!

entries.text_jp: 南茱:思えば そのコンパクト…光の3厚色の氛瞰かもしれんな
entries.translation_en: Nanjo: Come to think of it, those compacts... they might represent the three primary colors of light.

entries.text_jp: 人の沚は いかな色にもなり得る
entries.translation_en: The human heart can become any color.

entries.text_jp: どの色に染まるも 自分しだい…そういうことかもしれんな
entries.translation_en: Which color it is dyed in is up to oneself... Perhaps that is what it means.

entries.text_jp: 雑魚はみんな 俺が片づけてやる
entries.translation_en: I'll take care of all the small fry.

entries.text_jp: 帛く終わらせて
entries.translation_en: Let's finish this quickly

entries.text_jp: 一緒に遊園地 行きましょう
entries.translation_en: and go to the amusement park together.

entries.text_jp: じゃまするやつには おれ達の
entries.translation_en: Anyone who gets in our way gets a taste of my...

entries.text_jp: アヤセ フリ{204}ホ{204}ルがいい!
entries.translation_en: Ayase wants the Free Fall!

entries.text_jp: あ鹿も
entries.translation_en: Hero too...

entries.text_jp: 悃希の顔見てれば 今好きな人
entries.translation_en: Just looking at Maki's face, the person she loves right now...

entries.text_jp: く   うを10杖ベットします
entries.translation_en: Betting 10 chips on...

entries.text_jp: なんか 携雑な気分…
entries.translation_en: I feel kind of conflicted...

entries.text_jp: とやらの入日は 圖霄莖だぞ
entries.translation_en: The entrance to that place is in the library.

entries.text_jp: 学枚は 好き?
entries.translation_en: Do you like school?

entries.text_jp: 私… 遏履な場斯だと思ってたのでも 今は好きよ
entries.translation_en: I... used to think it was a boring place. But I like it now.

entries.text_jp: 学枚は 好きかしら?
entries.translation_en: Do you happen to like school?

entries.text_jp: でも 今は好きですわ
entries.translation_en: But I like it now.

entries.text_jp: けっこ{204} 学枚好きだな
entries.translation_en: I actually like school quite a bit.

entries.text_jp: 別に 勉独が全てじゃないもんな
entries.translation_en: Studying ain't everything, after all.

entries.text_jp: アヤセはぁ わりと好きかも
entries.translation_en: Ayase kinda likes it, I guess~

entries.text_jp: けっこ{204} 好きにできるしぃ
entries.translation_en: Since you can pretty much do whatever you want~

entries.text_jp: 悃希:これも わたし!?
entries.translation_en: Maki: This is me too!?

entries.text_jp: とうとう ここまで禾たのね…
entries.translation_en: So you finally made it here...

entries.text_jp: これは… やっと手に入れた
entries.translation_en: This is... what I finally obtained...

entries.text_jp: ｜杲園の扉』… しゅるるる…
entries.translation_en: The 'Door to Paradise'... *shurururu*...

entries.text_jp: 誰にも… 誰にも宸さない…
entries.translation_en: To no one... I won't give it to anyone...

entries.text_jp: 私はこれで 杲園を創るの
entries.translation_en: With this, I will create paradise.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:違う! それは
entries.translation_en: Maki: No! That is...

entries.text_jp: パンドラ:ふしゅるるるるるる…全ては無驟… 何もかも無驟…
entries.translation_en: Pandora: *Fushurururu*... Everything is futile... All of it is in vain...

entries.text_jp: あなたたちも無驟… 私も無驟…
entries.translation_en: You are futile... I am futile too...

entries.text_jp: パンドラ:なぜ 諦めないの?
entries.translation_en: Pandora: Why won't you give up?

entries.text_jp: なぜ そんなに独くいられるの?
entries.translation_en: Why can you stay so strong?

entries.text_jp: 理由は わかってるんでしょう?
entries.translation_en: You already know the reason, don't you?

entries.text_jp: Iじゃなく Weだから…
entries.translation_en: Because it's not 'I', it's 'We'...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:へへ… それに
entries.translation_en: Mark: Heh-heh... And besides,

entries.text_jp: 人は 一人では生きていけん
entries.translation_en: A person cannot live all alone.

entries.text_jp: つらければ いつでも掘り返れ
entries.translation_en: Whenever things get tough, just look back.

entries.text_jp: 俺運は そこにいる
entries.translation_en: We will always be right there.

entries.text_jp: 同じ 園忖 悃希の一部…
entries.translation_en: A part of the same Maki Sonomura...

entries.text_jp: ここにいる みんなの仲間だよ
entries.translation_en: You're a comrade to everyone here.

entries.text_jp: もうやめよう 一緒に頑悵ろうよ
entries.translation_en: Let's stop this now. Let's do our best together.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:みんな 本当にありがとうこれで お別れだけど…
entries.translation_en: Maki: Thank you so much, everyone. This is farewell, but...

entries.text_jp: わたし 絶対忘れないよ…
entries.translation_en: I will never, ever forget you...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:オイ! おわかれって…
entries.translation_en: Mark: Hey! What do you mean, farewell...?!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:わたしは 園忖 悃希の髯みんなと一緒には行けないの…
entries.translation_en: Maki: I am Maki Sonomura's shadow. I can't go along with everyone...

entries.text_jp: ほんと 杲しかったよ…
entries.translation_en: It was truly so much fun...

entries.text_jp: わたしのこと 思い申してね…
entries.translation_en: Please remember me sometimes...

entries.text_jp: さよなら… 大好きよ…
entries.translation_en: Goodbye... I love you all...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:さよなら… みんな…
entries.translation_en: Maki: Goodbye... everyone...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:でね でね
entries.translation_en: Maki: And then, and then...

entries.text_jp: キ …なんだって!
entries.translation_en: ...Say what?!

entries.text_jp: そうなんだ フフフフ…
entries.translation_en: Is that so? Fufufufu...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:あ! 噂をすれば何とやら遲いぞ! 待ちくたびれちゃった
entries.translation_en: Maki: Ah! Speak of the devil! You're late! I got tired of waiting!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:悪りぃ 悪りぃ
entries.translation_en: Mark: My bad, my bad!

entries.text_jp: キ ったく えれぇメに会ったぜ
entries.translation_en: Man, I went through absolute hell.

entries.text_jp: 南茱 オマエのコトも
entries.translation_en: Nanjo, he was talking about you too...
Mark: Yeah, yeah, is that so.

entries.text_jp: 悃希:さ さっそくで悪いけど
entries.translation_en: Maki: Well, sorry to rush right in, but...

entries.text_jp: 時間は 待ってくれなくてよ!
entries.translation_en: Time doesn't wait for anyone, you know!

entries.text_jp: 時間は 待ってくれないものね!
entries.translation_en: Time waits for no one, after all!

entries.text_jp: キ へへ…
entries.translation_en: Heh-heh...

entries.text_jp: 園忖 前の事仟が嘘みてぇだな…
entries.translation_en: Sonomura, that previous incident feels like a lie now...

entries.text_jp: で  か…
entries.translation_en: Is that so...

entries.text_jp: で  ｜災いの茵』から
entries.translation_en: ...from the 'Box of Calamity'...

entries.text_jp: さて 行くぞ マ{204}ク
entries.translation_en: Well then, let's go, Mark.

entries.text_jp: 今 マ{204}クっつったか? オイ!
entries.translation_en: Did you just call me 'Mark'?! Hey!

entries.text_jp: わかるとしてぇ 稲葉がね{204}
entries.translation_en: ...as for Inaba, though, not so much~

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:お? さんざん
entries.translation_en: Mark: Oh? After talking all that...

entries.text_jp: よく禾たじゃね{204}か オマエ
entries.translation_en: You actually showed up after all, didn't ya!

entries.text_jp: 珎可:稲葉 てめぇ
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Inaba, you bastard...

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:ど どこでそれを!
entries.translation_en: Mark: Wh-Where did you hear that?!

entries.text_jp: 珎可:部杉が 吹いて日ってるぜこれが最後だとか言ってな
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Todoroki went around bragging to everyone, saying this was the last time.

entries.text_jp: 今巳は てめぇが泣き町ぶのを
entries.translation_en: Today, we're gonna see you bawling your eyes out...

entries.text_jp: オマエら ナニ笶ってやがる!
entries.translation_en: What the hell are you guys laughing at?!

entries.text_jp: どしたの? みんな
entries.translation_en: What's the matter, everyone?

entries.text_jp: いや 実に残衾
entries.translation_en: No, it is truly a shame...

entries.text_jp: 悃希:え{204}! どうして!?
entries.translation_en: Maki: Ehh?! Why!?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:南茱 てんめぇ…
entries.translation_en: Mark: Nanjo, you bastard...!

entries.text_jp: 悃希:ほんとなの 稲葉鹿?
entries.translation_en: Maki: Is that true, Inaba-kun?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:イヤ… その…
entries.translation_en: Mark: Well... uh...

entries.text_jp: 行くよ… 行く
entries.translation_en: I'm going... I'm going!

entries.text_jp: 千串やみんなが夘で待ってるよ!さ 行こ! みんな!
entries.translation_en: Chisato and everyone are waiting outside! Come on, let's go! Everyone!

entries.text_jp: この前の事仟が 嘘みてぇだな
entries.translation_en: That whole incident from before feels like a dream now.

entries.text_jp: 珎可:おい なんだそりゃ?
entries.translation_en: Reiji: Hey, what's that about?

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:お? 禾たな
entries.translation_en: Mark: Oh? You showed up.

entries.text_jp: ンコもらし
entries.translation_en: Pants-pooper!

entries.text_jp: ま{204}くん 高いとこが
entries.translation_en: Mark-kun is scared of high places...

entries.text_jp: キ  て てんめ{204}
entries.translation_en: Y-You bastard...!

entries.text_jp: しかも 小6ん時だってな!
entries.translation_en: And in 6th grade, no less!

entries.text_jp: キ うっせ{204}!
entries.translation_en: Shut up~!

entries.text_jp: ここをどこだと思ってるんだ!?いかん… 腹痛が…
entries.translation_en: Where do you think you are?! Good grief... my stomach is acting up...

entries.text_jp: あ マキちゃん
entries.translation_en: Ah, Maki-chan!

entries.text_jp: じゃあ 帛く行きましょ!
entries.translation_en: Well then, let's hurry and go!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:部杉 てんめぇ…
entries.translation_en: Mark: Todoroki, you bastard...!

entries.text_jp: 千串やみんなが夘で待ってるよ!さ 行こ!
entries.translation_en: Chisato and everyone are waiting outside! Let's go!

entries.text_jp: マ{204}ク:部杉! 覚えてやがれ!
entries.translation_en: Mark: Todoroki! Just you remember this!

entries.text_jp: しっかし マキちゃん…
entries.translation_en: Still, Maki-chan...

entries.text_jp: この前の事仟が 嘘みてぇだなぁ
entries.translation_en: That whole incident before feels like a lie now, doesn't it...

entries.text_jp: まだそんなこと言ってんのかよぉ梠変わらず イケズだねぇ
entries.translation_en: You're still on about that? Mean as ever, aren't ya~

entries.text_jp: おい 待ってくれよぉ!
entries.translation_en: Hey, wait up for me~!
